start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:mark-my-notices-read with database <the name of my own account database> and ids [\"told:2\"]."
no_lists_because: Marking a notice read writes its read_at in the person's own database; no list of yours holds it.
instructions: 1. Name the database your account keeps its rows in.
2. Say "Run workflow:mark-my-notices-read" with database and the ids.
3. A repeated mark writes nothing: a notice keeps the time it was first read.

worked_examples.title: Mark a notice read
worked_examples.given: The notice table holds told:2, unread.
worked_examples.hands_back: ids ["told:2"], read true, changed true, said "1 notice marked read.".
